data.body: **[P2] Do not convert JVM-fatal MDC capture failures into durable failures.** A direct or `CompletionException`-wrapped `VirtualMachineError`/`ThreadDeath` is routed through `finishInvocation`, returning `FAILED` instead of failing the Lambda invocation. Detect fatal causes before the initialization-failure callback and complete the result exceptionally so `execute()` rethrows them; retain durable-failure handling only for nonfatal capture errors. Add direct and wrapped fatal tests.
